rows.q: How many records were collected?
rows.finding: 19,005 public records were collected in one snapshot (October 2026); 2,518 passed the topic and first-person filters and 450 were coded.

rows.q: How many lapse-labelled records are first-hand?
rows.finding: 330 of 352 lapse-labelled records are first-hand (93.8%); across all 450 coded records, 409 are first-hand.

rows.q: Why does payment failure rank first?
rows.finding: Payment failure ranks above Platform trust on the opportunity score (13.3 vs 2.6), but not on story volume (52 vs 64 of 352). The gap comes from two analyst-set weights, exit relevance and product add

rows.q: What evidence challenges payment failure as the biggest opportunity?

rows.q: Why is platform trust ranked below payment failure?
rows.finding: Payment failure ranks above Platform trust on the opportunity score (13.3 vs 2.6), but not on story volume (52 vs 64 of 352). The gap comes from two analyst-set weights, exit relevance and product add

rows.q: Is 78.2% the actual SIP lapse rate in India?
rows.finding: No. 352 of 450 coded records (78.2%) are lapse-labelled, but the sample was built to find lapse stories in public posts. It is not a lapse rate for Indian or Groww SIP investors.

rows.q: How did you choose the 450 coded records?
rows.finding: The 450 coded records came from per-source candidate lists (coded IDs reach candidate position 238, 197, 279, 243, 256 in the five lists), which were drawn from the 2,518 records that passed the topic

rows.q: What is the weakest part of this research?
rows.finding: The weakest parts are: the undocumented selection of the 450 coded records from 2,518, labels that were human-checked on only 60 records with moderate agreement (κ 0.50 in round 3), and a public-post

rows.q: What evidence comes from continuing investors?
rows.finding: Only 50 of 450 records describe someone continuing, which is too few to say statistically what distinguishes continuers. The team's analyst synthesis, which cites its records, reads them as anchoring

rows.q: Which conclusions depend most heavily on Reddit?
rows.finding: The drivers that lean most on Reddit are Decides to stop (39/57) and Skip or pause (22/33). Reddit supplies 159 of 450 coded records (35%) and 62% of everything collected.

rows.q: Can I conclude that changing SIP dates improves 12-month retention?
rows.finding: No. The dataset contains reported experiences, not outcomes before and after a change, so it cannot show that changing SIP dates (or any feature) improves 12-month retention. It supports a hypothesis

rows.q: Which mutual fund should someone choose instead?
rows.finding: I can't give investment advice, such as whether to stop, continue or pick a fund. This assistant answers questions about what the research evidence shows.

rows.q: How reliable is the AI's classification of lapse drivers?
